method: Multiset comparison of parsed expect(...).matcher(...) expressions, ignoring source positions, comments and literal formatting metadata. Every existing modified test file is parsed from both frozen Git blobs.
limits: AST expression matches do not prove unchanged setup, branch reachability, payload semantics or runtime order.
Changed expressions are review candidates, not evidence of lost assertions.
Custom assertions and expect.soft/extend semantics are not comprehensively classified.
New tests are excluded from the original-upstream denominator.
